This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial service prepared in accordance with the format in Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes as the only solicitation; proposals are being requested, and a written solicitation will not be issued. This solicitation number 15DDHQ27R00000001 is being used as a Request for Proposal (RFP). This will be solicited under FAR 12 Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. See attached for details. 

 Extend offers due date.
